narrow_supported_copy.title: A 2000 Review Described the Scope and Sourcing Limits of Red Mafiya
narrow_supported_copy.description: On November 16, 2000, The New York Review of Books published Raymond Bonner’s review of Robert I. Friedman’s Red Mafiya. The review described the book as an account of Russian mobsters with criminal enterprises across countries and cautioned that the book had no notes, leaving some of its findings difficult to trace. This is supported context about the book and its review; the accessed sources do not establish a Trump connection.
